definitions.ask: Should the mark spell out the word "frees" next to the key?
definitions.why: The point is to catch your eye while you plan, and "frees 2" needs no legend.

choices.label: Reads "🔑 frees 2": readable without hovering and word-for-word the BLOCKS row summary
Reads "🔑 2": about half as wide, so you learn what it means from the tooltip
